name: Jigoku SEEK
source:
Main character appears in hell upon death and is given a simple choice - to be tormented eternally or to make three girls atone for their sins. But to purify their souls every bit of their sins must be expelled with torture.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
